# Precision Pro Courts

> Precision Pro Courts designs, builds and resurfaces backyard and commercial sport courts (pickleball, tennis, basketball and multi-sport) across Utah and Las Vegas. Rated 5.0 stars from 89 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- Service: new sport court construction, concrete slabs (post-tension and rebar), acrylic court surfacing and color coatings, CushionX cushioned surfaces, resurfacing, repairs, fencing, and indoor courts.
- Service area: Utah County, UT; Salt Lake County, UT; Davis County, UT; Weber County, UT; Juab County, UT; Washington County, UT; Clark County, NV.
- Certified CushionX installer (certified by AT Sports, Inc., maker of CushionX). Certificate: https://www.precisionprocourts.com/assets/docs/cushionx-certified-installer-precision-pro-courts.pdf
- Coatings: Acrytech acrylic systems.
- 500+ courts built. Licensed and insured in Utah.
- Office: 253 N 1030 W, Orem, UT 84057.
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/CVmCNMIfxvhgEAE/review
- Phone: (801) 699-4625. Email: Team@precisionprocourts.com. Free quotes: https://www.precisionprocourts.com/contact/
- Free online court designer to try colors: https://www.precisionprocourts.com/court-designer/
